table.retrieve:
SELECT	
	UserName = (SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = S.SalesManCode),
	GroupType=:ar_group,
	GroupName= 
		CASE :ar_group
		WHEN 'M' THEN (SELECT M.NAME FROM MANUFACTURER M WHERE M.MANFCODE  = I.ManfCode)
		WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCATEGORY C WHERE C.ICATCODE  = I.ICatCode)
		WHEN 'L' THEN (SELECT C.NAME FROM ITEMCLASS C WHERE C.ICCODE  = I.ICCode)
		ELSE (SELECT P.NAME FROM ITEMPACKING P WHERE P.PACKCODE  = I.PACKCODE) END,   
	ItemName=I.Name,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	SaleQty = SUM(S.SaleQty),
	Sales=SUM(S.Sales),
	ReturnQty = SUM(S.ReturnQty),
	Ret=SUM(S.Ret),
	CGS=SUM(S.Cost),
	Stock=ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.CurrQty * IT.AvgPrice) FROM GodownDetail GD, Item IT WHERE GD.ICode = I.ICode AND GD.ICode=IT.ICode), 0)
FROM	
	(SELECT	
		TYPE='S', 
		SD.ICode, 
		SL.SalesManCode,
		SaleQty = SUM(SD.looseqty + SD.packqty + SD.BonusQty),
		Sales=IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0),
		ReturnQty = 0.0000,
		Ret = 0.00,
		Cost= - SUM((SD.LooseQty+SD.BonusQty) * SD.AvgPrice)
	FROM	SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Item I
	WHERE	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND
		SL.SalesManCode IN (:ar_usercode) AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		CASE :ar_group
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ar_groupcode)
	GROUP BY SL.SaleInvCode, SL.SalesManCode, SD.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	TYPE='S', SD.ICode, SL.SalesManCode, 
		SaleQty = SUM(SD.looseqty + SD.BonusQty),
		Sales=IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty) * (SD.saleprice - SD.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0),
		ReturnQty = 0.0000,
		Ret = 0.00,
		Cost= - SUM((SD.LooseQty+SD.BonusQty) * SD.AvgPrice)
	FROM	SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD, Item I
	WHERE	SL.ImpactInventory='N' AND
		SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND
		SL.SalesManCode IN (:ar_usercode) AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		CASE :ar_group
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ar_groupcode)
	GROUP BY SL.SaleInvCode, SL.SalesManCode, SD.ICode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT	TYPE='R', SD.ICode, SL.SalesManCode, 
		SaleQty = 0.0000,
		Sales = 0.00,
		ReturnQty = SUM(SD.looseqty + SD.BonusQty),
		Ret = - IsNull( sum(round(((SD.looseqty + SD.packqty * SD.packunits) * SD.srprice ) * (1 - (.01 *  SD.discperc)),2))  ,0),
		Cost = SUM((SD.LooseQty+SD.BonusQty) * SD.AvgPrice)
	FROM	SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD, Item I
	WHERE	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
		SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND
		SL.SalesManCode IN (:ar_usercode) AND
		SD.ICode = I.ICode AND
		CASE :ar_group
		WHEN 'M' THEN I.manfcode
		WHEN 'C' THEN I.ICatCode
		WHEN 'L' THEN I.ICCode
		ELSE I.PACKCODE END IN (:ar_groupcode)
	GROUP BY SL.SRInvCode, SL.SalesManCode, SD.ICode) S,
	Item I
WHERE	
	S.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	S.SalesManCode, 
	I.ManfCode,
	I.ICatCode,
	I.ICCode,
	I.PackCode,
	I.name,
	I.customicode,
	I.Icode
ORDER BY
	UserName,
	GroupName,
	ItemName
